name: Shizuna Kadokura
source:
★A proud and fastidious swordswoman who hates men★

A girl from Amatsu, an island nation far to the east of the continent where the academy is located.

She comes from the Kadokura family, a prestigious and powerful family in the country, and hopes to study swordsmanship and magic in order to be recognized by the family.

She has fair skin, a toned, slender body, and surprisingly, a large chest.

She has a unique aura that keeps others away, and is cold towards Tsukasa as well. However, deep down she is very interested in him. She is Siegfried's nemesis.

[Translated from https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/mwa/index.html]
